sources.entry: Raneto - Knowledgebase platform that uses static Markdown files. (Source Code) MIT Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Raneto is a file-based, Markdown-powered knowledge base built on Node.js.
summary.what_it_does: Raneto serves a knowledge base whose content is stored as Markdown (.md) files in a content directory. The README says it supports searching both file names and file contents. It includes a Markdown editor that runs in the browser, and a login system to protect editing. Configuration can come from config/config.js, and environment variables override those values. Settings cover the site title, base URL, locale for UI translations, Google Analytics 4 ID, and the listen address and port (defaults 127.0.0.1:8080). The README describes it as simple and lightweight.
use_cases: Publish a internal knowledge base from Markdown files
Host project documentation as a wiki
Let a team edit Markdown pages in a browser
Build a simple self-hosted documentation site
notable: Content is stored entirely as plain Markdown files on disk
Browser-based Markdown editor, toggled by configuration
Full-text search over file names and file contents
caveats: The README does not provide install or run steps, so setup details are not stated here
Editing and login require enabling the authentication and allow_editing settings and setting admin credentials
The HOST variable is deprecated in favor of ADDRESS
